Name: Walls and Floors of the SNES
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
Here's an attempt at some wall and floor decor for your farm.

Most of the wallpapers are based on or from the battle backgrounds / PSI attacks from Earthbound. One from Mother 3. A handful each from Chrono Trigger, Robotrek, Metal Max Returns, Terranigma. One from Evermore and a couple from Live a Live.

The floors are based on or from the same games as above, but swap Metal Max for Tengai Makyou Zero.

Not much to say on this one, hopefully these look ok. Not extensively tested. Probably would have looked better with the ability to do two tiles wide but hey here they are anyway. 

If you want to use these as a tilesheet in your mods, go for it, just leave me a comment or something so I can check it out.

haven't done these much before so feedback is welcome.
